command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_conduction_2d.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Eight columns of width 0.125 m. The left and right halves have conductivity 1 and 4 W/(m K) and volumetric capacity 2 and 3 J/(m³ K). T(x,t) equals cumulative thermal resistance to x plus t in SI units, corresponding to a uniform section flux of -1 W/m². The bulk source switches from +k to -2k at 0.125 s. The independently prescribed heater power is c minus the bulk source. Two 0.25 s output intervals are compared to exact column heat integrals. A separate insulated uniform test integrates a quadratic heater t² through 0.5 s and checks stored heat.
